title: Book Club Attendance Weekly Participation Trend
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bookclub:meeting
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as events sum(pages_read) as total_metric by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks weekly participation volume for book club attendance so momentum is easy to see.
value: Communities thrive on consistency, and a weekly trend shows whether the habit is strengthening or slipping.
implementation: Keep `pages_read` populated with the most meaningful contribution metric for the activity, such as miles, pages, or hours.
visualization: Column chart of weekly events and total pages read.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks whether book club attendance is happening regularly enough to stay part of your routine.
